description: Official LuciferCore framework: A high-performance, fully asynchronous .NET ecosystem designed for Modulith architectures. Fuses Data-Oriented Design (DOD) with high-speed OOP pooling to achieve zero-allocation pipelines and maximum CPU cache locality. Powered by a lock-free Buffer-Model architecture and a lightweight static DI container designed to fully saturate multi-core hardware. Automating infrastructure so you can focus 100% on core logic.
releaseNotes:
LuciferCore.Generators Hybrid DOD-OOP Memory Layout Update

      Core Architectural Enhancements
      - Compile-Time Property Generation: Leverages Roslyn Source Generators to automatically inspect fields or partial properties tagged with [LayoutIndex], weaving hyper-optimized PascalCase accessor routines directly into the in-memory compilation pipeline.
      - Meta-Header Shield Validation: Implemented a strict 12-byte safety boundary (4-byte Magic Number, 4-byte Version, and 4-byte Total Fields Count) preventing incorrect buffer attachments and ensuring cross-version memory resilience.
      - Dynamic Delta Shifting Mechanism: Engineered a raw memory-relocation routine powered by high-speed hardware-level Buffer Shifting. When variable-length layouts (like UTF-8 strings) expand or shrink, subsequent table offsets are automatically synchronized sequentially, completely eradicating runtime Reflection overhead.
      - Object-Pool-Safe Lifecycle Guard: Fully integrated with LuciferPool architecture, utilizing strict CheckSafety checks on public properties while preserving private raw buffer pointers for thầm lặng tear-downs, rendering memory leaks and Use-After-Free bugs impossible.

      Performance Breakthrough Results
      - Zero-Allocation Layout Operations: By bypassing standard C# backing-field auto-generations, memory layout maps and object lookups achieve absolute 0-byte allocations on the Managed Heap.
      - High-Throughput Memory Locality: Sequential layout ordering ensures maximum CPU Cache Line usage, vastly multiplying Cache Locality and matching raw thô linear memory access speeds with flawless OOP developer experience.
title: LuciferCore by thuangf45: High-Performance Zero-Allocation Framework
